opennyai_summary.PREAMBLE:
Waseem vs State Of U.P. And Another on 20 April, 2023
Author: Subhash Chandra Sharma
Bench: Subhash Chandra Sharma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 82
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 13253 of 2022
Applicant :- Waseem
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- A.K. Mishra,Sati Shanker Tripathi Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material placed on record.
This anticipatory bail application (under section 438 Cr.P.C.) has been moved seeking bail in Case Crime No.510 of 2020, under sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. & Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Jewar, District Gautam Budh Nagar, during the pendency of trial.
opennyai_summary.facts:
It is submitted in this case applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated as being husband.
Further submitted that during investigation applicant was granted anticipatory bail.
opennyai_summary.decision:
After submission of charge sheet in pursuance of the process of the court, the applicant is under apprehension of imminent arrest.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he would not misuse the liberty of bail and would cooperate with the trial.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, perusal of record and the matter being matrimonial, the applicant is entitled to be released on anticipatory bail in this case during the pendency of trial.
In the event of arrest of the applicant- Waseem, shall be released on anticipatory bail on furnishing a personal bond of Rs. 25,000/- with two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the learned court everyday when case is fixed unless exempted;
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police office;
(iii) The applicant shall not leave India without the previous permission of the Court and if he has passport, the same shall be deposited by him before the S.S.P./S.P.
concerned.
In default of any of the conditions, this order will automatically stand vacated.
